title: Archer pawn: aim camera and reticle
intro: About 1 minute, three parts, you start each with End. Arisen must be an Archer; an Archer pawn in the party. Part 3 is an experiment on the camera.

steps.each_frame:
if not _G.AIMX then
  local A = { log = {}, draw = 0, upd = 0, drw = 0 }
  _G.AIMX = A
  local function note(s) A.last = s; if #A.log < 80 then A.log[#A.log + 1] = string.format("%.2f %s", os.clock(), s) end end
  local function obj(a) local ok, o = pcall(sdk.to_managed_object, a); if ok and o then pcall(o.add_ref, o); return o end return nil end
  local function hook(tn, mn, pre)
    local td = sdk.find_type_definition(tn); local m = td and td:get_method(mn)
    if not m then note("NO METHOD " .. tn .. "." .. mn); return end
    sdk.hook(m, function(args) pcall(pre, args) end, function(r) return r end)
  end
  hook("app.MainCameraController", "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", function(args)
    local ct = sdk.to_int64(args[3]) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    local e = { ct = ct, opt = sdk.to_int64(args[6]) & 0xFFFFFFFF, interp = obj(args[4]), pfx = obj(args[5]) }
    note(string.format("mcc.switchCamera type %d opt %d interp %s pfx %s", ct, e.opt, tostring(e.interp ~= nil), tostring(e.pfx ~= nil)))
    if ct == 7 then A.enter = e; A.want_exit = true elseif A.want_exit then A.exit = e; A.want_exit = false end
  end)
  hook("app.CameraManager", "switchDefaultCamera(app.CameraSwitchInterpParam)", function(args)
    A.def = { interp = obj(args[3]) }; note("cm.switchDefaultCamera interp " .. tostring(A.def.interp ~= nil))
  end)
  hook("app.CameraManager", "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam)", function(args)
    note("cm.switchCamera type " .. tostring(sdk.to_int64(args[3]) & 0xFFFFFFFF))
  end)
  hook("app.GuiManager", "drawAim(via.Point, System.Single, System.Boolean)", function(args)
    A.draw = A.draw + 1
    A.draw_i = sdk.to_int64(args[3])
    local ok, f = pcall(sdk.to_float, args[4]); A.draw_f = ok and f or nil
    A.draw_b = (sdk.to_int64(args[5]) & 1) == 1
  end)
  hook("app.Player", "drawReticle", function() A.drw = A.drw + 1 end)
  hook("app.Player", "updateReticle", function() A.upd = A.upd + 1 end)
  note("hooks installed")
else
  local A = _G.AIMX
  A.c_t0, A.c_done, A.c_res, A.x_done, A.x_res, A.d_res, A.pt, A.snap = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  A.d_fail, A.s_t0 = nil, nil
end

steps.text: 1/3 BASELINE. As the ARISEN (Archer, bow out), no enemies needed. Press End, then HOLD AIM (right mouse) for the whole 6 s
ARISEN: HOLD AIM now... keep holding

expect.label: Arisen: a camera switch call was captured

steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMX; if not A then return end
A.s_t0 = A.s_t0 or os.clock()
if not A.snap and os.clock() - A.s_t0 > 2.0 then
  A.snap = true
  A.enter0, A.exit0, A.def0 = A.enter, A.exit, A.def
  A.draw0 = { i = A.draw_i, f = A.draw_f, b = A.draw_b, n = A.draw }
end

steps.text: 2/3 PAWN, nothing changed. Possess the ARCHER pawn (F6, F7 to cycle). Press End, then HOLD AIM for the whole 6 s
PAWN: HOLD AIM now... keep holding (just measuring)

expect.label: (info) pawn: game switched to the aim camera by itself
(info) pawn: upper body in an aim node

steps.text: 3/3 EXPERIMENT (may misbehave; save first if you like). Still possessing the Archer: press End, then HOLD AIM for 10 s. After 1 s the test switches to the aim camera; after 4 s it draws the reticle. WATCH: zoom? reticle? do arrows hit where it points?
PAWN: HOLD AIM and shoot a few arrows... (1 s: aim camera, 4 s: reticle)
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMX; if not A then return end
A.c_t0 = A.c_t0 or os.clock()
local dt = os.clock() - A.c_t0
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); if not cm then return end
local mcc = cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return end
if not A.c_done and dt > 1.0 then
  A.c_done = true
  local e = A.enter0
  if e then
    local ok, err = pcall(mcc.call, mcc, "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", 7, e.interp, e.pfx, e.opt)
    A.c_res = "replayed the Arisen's aim switch ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. (ok and "" or (" " .. tostring(err)))
  else
    A.c_res = "nothing to replay: no aim switch was captured from the Arisen"
  end
end
if dt > 4.0 and A.draw0 and A.draw0.i and not A.d_fail then
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    if not A.pt then
      local x, y = A.draw0.i & 0xFFFFFFFF, (A.draw0.i >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
      if not (x > 0 and x < 20000 and y > 0 and y < 20000) then error("captured point not usable: " .. tostring(A.draw0.i)) end
      local pt = ValueType.new(sdk.find_type_definition("via.Point"))
      pcall(function() pt:set_field("x", x); pt:set_field("y", y) end)
      local okr, rx = pcall(pt.get_field, pt, "x")
      if not (okr and rx == x) then pt:write_dword(0, x); pt:write_dword(4, y) end
      A.pt = pt; A.pt_xy = x .. "," .. y
    end
    local f = A.draw0.f
    if not (type(f) == "number" and f > 0.01 and f < 20) then f = 1.0 end
    local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager")
    gm:call("drawAim(via.Point, System.Single, System.Boolean)", A.pt, f, A.draw0.b == true)
    A.d_res = "drawing reticle at " .. tostring(A.pt_xy) .. " scale " .. tostring(f)
  end)
  if not ok then A.d_fail = true; A.d_res = "reticle failed: " .. tostring(err) end
elseif dt > 4.0 and not A.d_res then
  A.d_res = "no reticle draw was captured from the Arisen"
end

expect.label: experiment: aim camera engaged for the pawn

steps.text: Release aim. Camera going back to normal
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMX; if not A then return end
if not A.x_done then
  A.x_done = true
  local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0)
  if not mcc then return end
  local cur = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController")
  local name = cur and cur:get_type_definition():get_name() or "?"
  if not name:find("Aim", 1, true) then A.x_res = "camera already back (" .. name .. ")"; return end
  local e = A.exit0
  local ok, err
  if e then ok, err = pcall(mcc.call, mcc, "switchCamera(app.CameraDefine.ControlType, app.CameraSwitchInterpParam, app.PostEffectSetting, app.CameraDefine.ToPlayerCameraOption)", e.ct, e.interp, e.pfx, e.opt); A.x_res = "replayed the Arisen's exit switch ok=" .. tostring(ok)
  else ok, err = pcall(cm.call, cm, "switchDefaultCamera(app.CameraSwitchInterpParam)", (A.def0 and A.def0.interp) or (A.enter0 and A.enter0.interp)); A.x_res = "switchDefaultCamera ok=" .. tostring(ok) end
  if not ok then A.x_res = A.x_res .. " " .. tostring(err) end
end

expect.label: (info) share of this step still on the aim camera

steps.text: Done. If the camera is stuck zoomed: F6 to release, aim once as the Arisen
